name: draft-edge-live-sync
description: Watches a live Yahoo Fantasy Basketball auction draft and overlays budget, inflation, and value-pick recommendations in real time.

scripts.fetch-stats: NODE_USE_ENV_PROXY=1 node --no-warnings stats/fetch_htb.js && npm run -s stats
scripts.injuries: NODE_USE_ENV_PROXY=1 node --no-warnings season/fetch_injuries.js && npm run -s season
scripts.morning: npm run -s fetch-stats && npm run -s injuries && npm run -s report

author: Alex
